text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","TCP_FLAGS","CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS","SERVER_TCP_FLAGS","TCP_WIN_MAX_IN","TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT","RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"For non-TCP IP protocols, TCP flags, TCP windows, and TCP retransmission measurements have no TCP packets to describe and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] == 0) & (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_TYPE","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"For IPv4 flows that are not ICMP, ICMP type and code measurements are inapplicable and are represented as zero."}]}
